title: drag-lint Panel (dockable)
summary: Opens the main drag-lint dockable tool window inside the IDE
intro: Read this when you want the main drag-lint tool window docked beside your editor instead of as a separate window. Choose drag-lint > drag-lint Panel (dockable); it only needs the IDE plugin loaded.

steps: The main drag-lint tool window opens as a dockable window; drag it where you want it to stay docked

questions.ask: How do I dock the main drag-lint panel beside my editor?
